intent: Allow verifying a delivery before it is deployed, to record a dry run.

edit.summary:
I proposed two changes in the `delivery` domain. I did not touch the invariant `verified-requests-were-deployed`, and that will probably be a problem.

- **`transitions.DeliveryRequest.matrix.built.verify`** (proposal E-11-ee58d09f): in the `built` stage (called `previewed` in the guide), `verify` now leads to `verified`. Before, it was n/a there.
- **`actions.verify`** (proposal E-11-9f83ac11): I removed the `deployed` precondition, "Only a deployment that happened can be verified." I also changed the description to say verification can be recorded before deployment as a dry run. The rest of the action is unchanged.

**Invariant conflict:** `verified-requests-were-deployed` says a request at stage `verified` must have `deployed == true`. A dry run before deployment breaks that rule, so the check will probably flag it. Changing it weakens a safety rule, so I left it for you to decide.

**Final stage:** `verified` is a final stage. A dry run recorded this way would block the real verification after the actual deploy.

I used `change_request` as the source kind for the matrix cell. You may want to check that this is accepted.
